sloka: ते श्रान्त वाहना दूता विकृष्टेन सता पथा ।गिरि व्रजम् पुर वरम् शीघ्रम् आसेदुर् अन्जसा ॥२-६८-२१॥
transliteration: te śrānta vāhanā dūtā vikṛṣṭena satā pathā ।giri vrajam pura varam śīghram āsedur anjasā ॥2-68-21॥

translations.english: After a prolonged journey the messengers with their tired horses soon reached Girivraja, the (capital city of Kekaya kingdom) best of cities.
